{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check the cleaned revenue
print(sales['revenue_clean'].head())

# Confirm the QA rows check: any revenue == 999999.99?
print("\nNumber of QA rows (revenue == 999999.99):", (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
